scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @research-os/web && npm run build --workspace @research-os/server && npm run build --workspace research-os-mastra
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @research-os/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @research-os/server && npm run typecheck --workspace research-os-mastra
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,mastra "npm run dev --workspace @research-os/server" "npm run dev --workspace research-os-mastra"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,mastra "npm run start --workspace @research-os/server" "npm run start --workspace research-os-mastra"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:check
